long_biography.plain_text:
Italian industrialist Marco Zigon shares a winemaking project with his wife at Terre di Tora, her farm in the hills near Caserta. She established the enterprise to revive her family's chestnut grove, hazelnut grove and old vineyard. Zigon works with oenologist Riccardo Cotarella on the wines.

When Cotarella visited in 2018, he judged the volcanic foothills' climate, terrain and sunlight suitable for producing Aglianico from a single grape variety. Zigon credits the oenologist's expertise for the results. Their Rebalto is fermented in steel and matured in barriques, while the range also includes a rosé sparkling wine.
